online_scenarios: Cancellation arriving before preparation prevents allocation (410).
Closing revokes the original playlist and its segment (410).
A late cancellation does not revoke replacement playback (200 heartbeat and valid replacement playlist).
Closing during preparation prevents the returned request from resuming playback (410).
The own diagnostic session logged out successfully.
race_regressions: Superseded native retry cannot acquire a replacement provider account.
Old HLS tickets cannot renew a reservation owned by a newer playback.
Player teardown continues after individual player errors.
Delayed HLS library setup cannot resurrect closed playback.
Old heartbeat cannot close a replacement; idle access revocation is preserved.
Session expiration deletes its playback ownership state.
Cancellation delivery is idempotent, validates acknowledgement, retries at most twice and never creates a playback.

native_disconnect_probe.verification_error: Post-disconnect control reply did not contain user_info; count could not be verified.

limitations: Server-side playback reservations are released upon receiving cancellation; network delivery cannot be assumed instantaneous.
Third-party HLS clients that provide no stop notification retain their idle-expiry safety window.
The Android APK and physical TVs were not modified or tested in this change.
